tweets.text:
Under President Trump’s strong leadership, and with Secretary Noem’s direction, we are conducting removal flights for Mexican nationals, repatriating them deep into southern Mexico.

Mexican nationals arrested by the Border Patrol are being repatriated to southern Mexico, as far south as the Mexican/Guatemalan border.  We are leveraging all federal resources and state partnerships, to include Department of State, DHS, DOJ, and DOD to ensure illegal aliens are arrested, prosecuted when warranted, and removed far away from the U.S.-Mexico border.

Since January 20, 2025,
14 total Mexican repatriation flights
1,650 subjects

tweets.text:
NO TRESPASSING🚨
Yesterday, USBP agents responded to Fort Huachuca Army Installation near Garden Canyon, AZ, after military police called for assistance. Four illegal aliens attempted to evade detection by trespassing on the base.
•All individuals will be prosecuted for trespassing on military base (18USC1382)
•Two will be prosecuted for Illegal re-entry (8USC1326)
•Two others processed under Unlawful presences (212a9CiII) & Inadmissible alien (8USC1182)

USBP is committed to enforcing U.S. law- if you enter the country illegally, trespass, or break any law you face prosecution. Securing our homeland.
